name: Cindy Ping
description: Show desktop emotes. Display-only also cancels the previous pending action. Configure your own instructions and project, task or companion destinations. This version supports macOS 14+ devices only.
whenToUse: Desktop emotes, configurable reactions, window context collection, and tasks triggered by an emote.

status.description: Read wheel, capture-permission and delivery status. macOS 14+. Emotes can create a project task, add context to an existing task or send to a companion, with per-trigger selection or a fixed target. Requires cindy.targets support; legacy plugin-task bindings are retained. Actions can incur model costs and attach screenshots through Cindy managed media; no conversation history is returned.

get_config.description: Read the current Cindy Ping configuration and revision before editing. Preserve fields the user did not ask to change.

configure.description: Configure the wheel, emotes, instructions, actions, model routes, destinations, delivery and shortcut. Read get_config first, edit its complete config and submit its revision. Use list_targets/list_models for exact identifiers. STALE_REVISION requires re-reading. Saving does not display an emote, capture content, create a task or send a message.

list_targets.description: List available projects, conversations or companions with exact kind/id and display metadata, in host activity order. No conversation history.

list_models.description: List available models and complete routes, reasoning efforts and Fast support.
